column1: # Per-vector path-aware EDP -- exhaustive GRAY-CODE order (2^N x 2^N value pairs,
# consecutive vectors differ by exactly one bit of the combined A||B word).
# Single continuous process throughout, preserving cross-vector correlation.
# SD/TC-PM and SD/TC-PPM use the same canonical 2^N x 2^N encoding as their
# exhaustive-natural-order table (SD_a = value's own bits, SD_b = 0 always), so the
# combined word being Gray-coded is (SD_value||TC_value), matching RCA/CLA/TER's (A||B).
